KPlugin.Description: Fade the windows covering a window when it is raised; fade or scale in the raised window itself when a huge or almost fully covering window was in front of it
KPlugin.Description[zh_CN]: 窗口被提升时遮挡它的窗口渐隐后于其后方渐显；若前方是巨大的或几乎完全遮挡它的窗口，则改为对被提升窗口本身做显隐或缩放进入
KPlugin.Name: Better Transition
